line: Crowley on Atu XVIII: the letter Qoph, Pisces, the Moon as the most universal of the Planets, and Netzach and Malkuth (pdf p103, p104).

sections.title: Letter, sign and planet
sections.line: Crowley on the letter Qoph and Pisces, and on the Moon as the most universal of the Planets (pdf p103).

quotes.quote: The Eighteenth Trump is attributed to the letter Qoph, which represents Pisces in the Zodiac.
The Moon, partaking as she does of the highest and the lowest, and filling all the space between, is the most universal of the Planets.

sections.title: Netzach and Malkuth
sections.line: Crowley on the Moon in her lowest avatar joining Netzach with Malkuth (pdf p103) and on the threshold of life and the threshold of death (pdf p104).

quotes.quote: In this Trump, her lowest avatar, she joins the earthy sphere of Netzach with Malkuth,
This is the threshold of life; this is the threshold of death.
